source_boundary: Only official Wiley article pages used to verify authors, issue metadata, DOI and abstract-supported points. No PDF downloaded; no manuscript edits or submission actions.

records.title: Sequential monitoring for conditional quantiles of general conditional heteroscedastic time series models
records.abstract_supported_relevance_zh: 在线顺序监测位置–尺度异方差时序的条件分位数变点，摘要明确联系 VaR/ES 风险管理；用 KOSPI 与 EuroStoxx 50 日收益实证。
records.short_abstract_quote: sequentially detect change points in the conditional quantiles
records.context_sentence_en: \citet{LeeKim2024ASMBI} develop sequential monitoring procedures for changes in conditional quantiles of heteroscedastic time series, with applications to financial return data.
records.suggested_use_zh: 用于说明金融条件分位数和时序稳定性已是本刊相关议题。
records.boundary_zh: 这是变点监测研究；摘要不能支持本稿模型优于其方法，或本稿静态评价量具有新颖性的结论。

records.title: Optimal Transport Autoregression to Forecast High-Frequency Financial Data Distributions
records.abstract_supported_relevance_zh: 用最优传输自回归预测 Bitcoin 高频收益与波动分布；摘要报告误差依赖时间与分位数，极端分位附近误差上升且不单调。
records.short_abstract_quote: forecast errors are highly time- and quantile-dependent
records.context_sentence_en: \citet{Pagnottoni2026ASMBI} study distributional forecasts of high-frequency Bitcoin returns and volatility, reporting forecast errors that vary across time and quantile levels.
records.suggested_use_zh: 用于说明应在多个分位和时间位置检查金融分布预测表现。
records.boundary_zh: 摘要针对其最优传输模型和 Bitcoin 数据；不能外推为所有金融模型的普遍定理，也不能据此声称本稿已解决极端分位问题。

records.title: Forecasting Gold Returns Volatility Over 1258–2023: The Role of Moments
records.abstract_supported_relevance_zh: 先用 Bayesian 时变参数分位回归构建波动、尾风险和矩指标，再作递归样本外线性预测并比较自回归基准。
records.short_abstract_quote: recursively estimated linear predictive regressions over the out-of-sample periods
records.context_sentence_en: \citet{MuddanaEtAl2025ASMBI} use quantile-regression-derived measures of tail risk and higher moments in recursive out-of-sample forecasts of gold-return volatility.
records.suggested_use_zh: 用于说明时间顺序的样本外验证和明确基准比较在本刊金融预测应用中的位置。
records.boundary_zh: 研究目标是波动预测，不能将其等同于本稿的分位损失目标或宣称摘要证明某种分位评价标准有效。
